# Content Creator Tweaks

**Content Creator Tweaks** is a Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric) modpack tailored specifically for content creators, streamers, and video editors. This pack bundles top-tier performance optimizations with essential recording tools, cinematic cameras, and quality-of-life features to make your gameplay smooth and your videos look absolutely professional. 

---

## About

Ready to take your content to the next level? **Youtubers Essentials** eliminates the headache of setting up individual mods for recording. It comes packed with everything you need to capture breathtaking cinematics, manage free-cam views, and customize your HUD for a cleaner on-screen look.

Best of all, we focused heavily on FPS stabilization. Record or stream in high quality without worrying about performance drops or micro-stutters, giving your audience the best viewing experience possible.

## Recommendations

* **Minimum RAM:** 4GB allocated to Minecraft
* **Recommended RAM:** 6–8GB (highly recommended while running OBS Studio or recording software)
* Shaders are fully supported via Iris to enhance your video visuals!
